# Axial Skyrmions
- The reflection operation changes the sign of only one pion field, resulting in a relative phase definition that differs by π from the approach used in refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is obtained by changing the sign of all three pion fields.
- This paper's definition provides a more natural comparison with the analogous situation for monopoles.
- The profile function vanishes at radius s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center, allowing the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion to be continuously patched together with vacuum fields set outside each core (3.10).
- Beyond the simple ansatz initial conditions (3.7), more sophisticated initial conditions were employed based on the rational map ansatz [11] using an axially symmetric charge n map.
